Token Cost Audit

What the audit covers

Input format compression

Run gcf-proxy against every MCP server. Measure JSON vs GCF token counts on your actual payloads. 50-71% savings typical.

Prompt caching

Check if your prompts are structured for provider-native caching. Anthropic offers 90% savings on cached tokens, OpenAI 50%. Many teams leave this unconfigured.

Model selection

Are you running Opus on Haiku tasks? We identify which calls can be routed to cheaper models without quality loss.

Session deduplication

In multi-turn agent sessions, the same data gets retransmitted on every call. GCF session dedup sends bare references for known symbols. 92% savings by the 5th call.

RAG optimization

Chunk sizing, reranking, and context injection strategy. Most teams retrieve too many chunks. Reranking before injection cuts tokens while improving answer quality.

Agent loop efficiency

Unnecessary tool calls, missing batching, redundant reads. We analyze your agent loop and identify where tokens are wasted on round-trip overhead.
